affected_system: affordable housing production, preservation, subsidy, and compliance system
alternatives: compare eligible treated and credible untreated units for phased affordable-housing acquisition and rehabilitation
estimate pre-specified overall and distributional effects of phased affordable-housing acquisition and rehabilitation
pair matched property event-study with tenant and restriction panels with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Units, affordability restrictions, occupancy, financing, condition, pipeline, and parcel feasibility are reconciled.
Modeled development feasibility is not treated as entitlement, financing close, or completed housing.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain pre-intervention conditions for phased affordable-housing acquisition and rehabilitation.

constraints.description: The affordable housing siting and preservation evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: housing development commissioner and affordable-housing finance director
decision_question: Did phased acquisition or rehabilitation preserve verified affordability and housing stability?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The affordable housing siting and preservation evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for phased affordable-housing acquisition and rehabilitation passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: matched property event-study with tenant and restriction panels
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in verified affordable home-years and tenant retention

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased affordable-housing acquisition and rehabilitation, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in verified affordable home-years and tenant retention
distributional gap in change in verified affordable home-years and tenant retention
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer causal anti-displacement or well-being effects from project completion alone.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for phased affordable-housing acquisition and rehabilitation passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.

title: Evaluate affordable-housing preservation interventions
transportability_risks: Land law, subsidy programs, construction costs, finance, tenant protections, and markets differ.
Observed transactions may omit informal displacement and off-market preservation risks.
